summary: Backend-only verification for TaskMint iter-21 changes (game daily-limit removal, Memory/Math reward formulas, wallet split, withdraw split + 2/day cap, transaction category filter, admin campaign credit). 24/24 backend tests pass after two minor backend fixes by tester.

minor.issue: Fixed by tester: legacy users (and the conftest TEST user fixture) lacked `campaign_points` / `games_task_points` fields, so the response omitted them. Added defaults in get_current_user (campaign_points=0, games_task_points=0, withdrawals_today=0, withdrawals_today_date=None).
Fixed by tester: legacy transactions stored before iter-21 have no `category` key, so they were returned without one. Endpoint now normalises every row to `category='games_task'` when missing/null.

action_items: Verify the two minor backend fixes look acceptable (server.py: get_current_user setdefaults + transactions legacy normalisation).

Note: frontend testing was explicitly skipped per request. Main agent should self-verify the UI flows (Wallet filter chips, Withdraw source picker, points-won popup, native ad placement, ad-rewarded chance loops on TTT/Memory/Math/HL, and the home string change to 'High Paying Campaigns').
critical_code_review_comments: server.py has grown to 2200+ lines and should be modularised (auth, wallet, games, admin into separate routers).
migrate_wallet_split() iterates every user on each startup; consider gating by a single 'migrated_v21' flag in a settings doc to avoid repeated full scans as user base grows.
WithdrawCreate.source default='games_task' — silent fallback could mask a frontend bug where source isn't sent; consider making it required (no default) once the FE is verified to always pass it.

admin_update_withdraw refunds via $inc on legacy `points` only, but does NOT refund back into the bucket (campaign_points / games_task_points) or write a category tag on the refund txn. Refunded amounts will desynchronise the buckets vs. legacy points.
updated_files: /app/backend/server.py (added wallet-split setdefaults in get_current_user; added legacy category normalisation in GET /wallet/transactions)
seed_data_creation: All test data is prefixed TEST_ and cleaned up in fixtures/finally blocks. test_migration_runs_on_startup restarts the backend supervisor unit to trigger the startup migration hook; service comes back automatically.
context_for_next_testing_agent: iter21 suite at backend/tests/test_iteration21_taskmint.py covers wallet split, game limit removal, math/memory reward tiers, withdraw cap, and admin campaign credit. Re-running the migration test causes a backend restart (~5s). If new iterations alter add_points_and_log signature, update the campaign-approval test accordingly.
rca_of_issue: The two minor fixes had the same root cause: iter-21 added new user fields (`campaign_points`, `games_task_points`) and a new transaction field (`category`) but did not back-fill them in API responses for legacy records. Symptom: any user/transaction created before the migration ran would silently miss the new fields in API responses, breaking FE assumptions (e.g. wallet header reading user.campaign_points => undefined => NaN). Mitigation: setdefault in the auth path and a per-row normaliser in the transactions endpoint guarantee the contract regardless of stored shape.
